text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I will eclipse every glory born in this 
country, and eventually shine brilliantly 
atop the world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though it may be virtually unprecedented, 
Sirius Symboli proclaims it with utter 
confidence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Moved by her strong, unwavering words and 
eyes, the curtain rose on their journey 
through the Twinkle Series.
